title: Secret radiation testing of animals after Pacific nuclear tests

tellings.quote: one of the early documents I found in the Australian archives were was evidence of secret testing of animals for radiation residue from those nuclear experiments

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart tells Michels that one of the first things he found in Australia's national archives was evidence that animals had been secretly tested for leftover radiation from nuclear experiments in the Pacific, apparently in the 1950s and 60s and involving Australia and New Zealand. Coulthart offers it as an early sign that governments were hiding things from their own people. He does not give more detail on what the records show.
